# Korean terminology

Use these defaults consistently while retaining official product names:

| English | Korean |
| --- | --- |
| assignment | 과제 |
| exercise | 실습 |
| step | 단계 |
| workflow | 워크플로 |
| trigger | 트리거 |
| repository | 리포지토리 |
| branch | 브랜치 |
| pull request | 풀 리퀘스트 |
| issue | 이슈 |
| commit | 커밋 |
| push | 푸시 |
| GitHub Actions | GitHub Actions |
| GitHub Copilot | GitHub Copilot |
| custom instructions | 사용자 지정 지침 |
| agent | 에이전트 |
| Agent Skill | Agent Skill |
| template | 템플릿 |
| validation | 검증 |

Do not translate exact UI labels, workflow names, identifiers, filenames, paths,
commands, or checked phrases merely to match this table. Preserve the source
token and, when helpful, explain it in adjacent Korean prose.
